changes.before: The HTTP resource decoder also distinguishes JSON numbers from strings: numeric CPU is already millicores, while a CPU string such as "1" passes through ParseCPU and means 1,000 millicores. A raw numeric0 is rejected, whereas an absent field represents omission. Therefore copying a Go zero-valued struct into raw JSON is not equivalent to omitting resource fields.
